items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: near the end of the Second Herd. And Shadow Wilson was on drums

ctx.x: Right, there was a lot of movement, a lot of movement, yeah. I had one very fantastic experience that I think should be related.

I had a band -- at this point, it was near the end of the Second Herd. And Shadow Wilson was on drums, and Oscar was still there, I believe -- I can't be positive about that. But Gene was and Ernie, and somebody else, I think.
